Author: Alok Kumar Verma
Bench: Alok Kumar Verma
 Office Notes,
S reports, orders
L. or proceedings
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S N or directions and o Registrar's order  with Signatures  16.01.2024 WPCRL No. 40 of 2024  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

Present Petition has been filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India to of 2023, registered at Vigilance Establishment, Vigilance Sector, Dehradun District Dehradun under Sections 420, 467,
468, 471, 218, Section 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, Section 13(1)(a) and Section 13(1)(c)
read with Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.
2. Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Bhaskar Joshi, learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. Mr. Sandeep Kothari, Advocate, has submitted that the petitioner, aged about 61 years, was Assistant Collector in the year, 2010.
He has been falsely implicated in the present matter.
He does not have any criminal antecedents.

One co-accused has been granted interim relief under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, and, co- accused persons have been granted Interim Anticipatory Bail in the present matter.
4.
Learned counsel for the State has sought four weeks' time to file counter affidavit.

5. List on 19.03.2024 along with WPCRL No. 1690 of 2023.
6.
Till then, the petitioner-Harbeer Singh shall not be arrested provided he cooperates with the investigation.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) Vacation Judge 16.01.2024 Shiksha WPCRL/40/2024 on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122462277/
